anchor: Plan v10 Track SS — UK devolved tax variation. Corporation Tax is not devolved (25% UK-wide; small profits rate 19% under £50k) but Scotland sets income tax bands separately (affects sole traders + partnerships), Wales has Land Transaction Tax instead of SDLT, and NI applies separate employer-NIC regime via NICs Holiday for some manufacturers.
convention: corporate_income_tax stays at UK federal 25% across regions. pit_top reflects top income tax band for sole traders / partnerships. Scotland's banding diverges from rest of UK above £43k. employer_nic stays UK-wide unless noted.

default_country_rate.notes: UK Corporation Tax. Devolved variations affect PIT (Scotland) + transaction taxes (Wales) + employer reliefs (NI).

GB-ENG.name: England
GB-ENG.notes: UK-standard PIT bands. Top rate 45% above £125k.

GB-SCT.name: Scotland
GB-SCT.notes: Scottish income tax bands more progressive: starter 19%, basic 20%, intermediate 21%, higher 42% (above £43.5k), advanced 45% (above £75k), top 48% (above £125k). Affects sole traders.

GB-WLS.name: Wales
GB-WLS.notes: Welsh rates of income tax = England equivalent. Land Transaction Tax replaces SDLT; commercial LTT 6% top band.

GB-NIR.name: Northern Ireland
GB-NIR.notes: Manufacturing-eligible firms benefit from NIC Employer reliefs not available in GB. Same income tax as England.
